summary: Full end-to-end testing of Task 2 (User Blocking + Reporting). Backend: 9/9 pytest tests pass (block CRUD, idempotent re-block, self-block 400, invalid id 400, missing user 404, block list + check endpoints, report validation, duplicate-dedup, admin list/update/stats, non-admin 403). Mutual-block filtering verified on /api/posts (search-scoped), /api/messages (403 both directions), /api/network/request (403 both directions), and /api/conversations. Frontend: ReportModal opens from PostMenu with all 8 reason radios + details + submit/cancel; report submits successfully. Block from PostMenu fires rtn:user-blocked event and removes post from feed without refresh (verified). SecuritySettings BlockedUsersPanel lists blocked users, unblock-btn-<id> removes row immediately. UserProfileView shows report-user-btn + block-user-btn for other users. AdminDashboard ReportsPanel renders with filter buttons reports-filter-pending/resolved/dismissed/all showing counts (PENDING(1) RESOLVED(3) DISMISSED(0)); dismiss button reduces pending count and shows toast.

backend: POST /api/moderation/block/{user_id} -> 201 first time, then 'already blocked' on retry (idempotent)
GET /api/moderation/blocks returns list with user_id/name/avatar/blocked_at fields
GET /api/moderation/blocks/check/{user_id} returns is_blocked_either_way + i_blocked_them flags symmetric for both sides
POST /api/moderation/report invalid target_type -> 400, invalid reason -> 400, missing target_id -> 400
POST /api/moderation/report valid + duplicate returns 'already submitted' (no extra row in admin list)
PUT /api/admin/reports/{id} resolves with note (verified persistence), invalid id -> 400, invalid status -> 400, non-admin -> 403
GET /api/admin/reports/stats returns {pending, resolved, dismissed} counts, non-admin -> 403
After block, demo's post no longer in admin's /api/posts feed (verified by title search)
GET /api/conversations does not include blocked user partner
frontend: Login (demo) -> feed loads with 20 post-menu buttons
Other-user post menu shows post-menu-report-<id> + post-menu-block-<id>

ReportModal opens with data-testid=report-modal, all 8 reason radios (spam, harassment, hate_speech, nsfw, scam, impersonation, violence, other) present, report-details-input, report-submit-btn, report-cancel-btn
Submitting report closes modal; report visible to admin in ReportsPanel
Clicking post-menu-block-<id> triggers confirm, calls API, dispatches rtn:user-blocked, and the post is removed from feed without refresh
Security -> BlockedUsersPanel (data-testid=blocked-users-panel) lists blocked rows; unblock-btn-<id> click removes row immediately
Clicking another user's avatar opens TraderProfile with report-user-btn + block-user-btn
Admin Dashboard renders admin-reports-panel with filter buttons reports-filter-pending/resolved/dismissed/all showing counts in labels
report-resolve-<id> and report-dismiss-<id> buttons present on pending rows; dismiss action removes row from pending list and shows 'Report dismissed' toast

critical_code_review_comments: moderation.py POST /block returns 201 the first time but 200 on idempotent re-block (status_code=201 decorator applies). Behaviour acceptable (both responses include message field) but consider unifying to 200 if the spec prefers idempotent semantics, or document that 201 only on first creation.

moderation.py POST /report uses @router.post decorator with status_code=201 even when duplicate path returns 'already submitted' (still 201). Functional but a 200 in the dedupe branch would be more accurate.
moderation.py list_my_blocks: unbounded loop over users_cursor could be expensive if a user has 500 blocks. Add an index on blocks.blocker_id and consider pagination.

moderation_utils.get_blocked_user_ids does a full $or scan on blocks per request on many feed endpoints. Recommend a compound index on (blocker_id) and (blocked_id) plus caching per-request to avoid duplicate DB hits if multiple routes call it in one request.
Reports collection lacks unique index on (reporter_id, target_type, target_id, status) - dedup is enforced at app level only; under race a duplicate could slip in.
PostCard handleBlockUser uses window.confirm (per system prompt this is flagged in style review). Works, but a styled Confirm modal would match the rest of the app.
seed_data_creation: Test created/deleted one post owned by demo user (cleaned up in test teardown). Test reports were created against synthetic target_ids (test-target-<uuid>) and were resolved/dismissed by admin during the run. One additional 'spam' report was submitted from the frontend flow against an admin post (TEST_ automated report) and dismissed via the admin UI. Block created during frontend flow was unblocked via BlockedUsersPanel.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Task 2 (Block + Report) end-to-end functional. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_moderation_block_report.py is the regression suite. Note that /api/posts has pagination at limit*3 default 100 so verifying feed visibility for a specific post requires search param. nav-security/nav-admin testids appear duplicated (desktop + mobile sidebar) - iterate visible ones. PostMenu Report/Block options only show for other users' posts (correct gating). rtn:user-blocked event triggers Feed.js handler to filter out posts client-side - confirmed working.
rca of the issue: N/A - all features functional as specified.
